status: FROZEN DESIGN; no thresholds or conditions changed

primary_matrix.status: NOT RUN; requires explicit owner authorization using the phrase GAS-0 Phase 2

metrics.rps: Arithmetic mean of cumulative requirement completion (CR) over the eight stages.

interval.method: cluster bootstrap over evaluation projects with seeds nested

metrics.robustness: Repeat verdict on logit scale of CR; if verdict differs, report scale-dependent.

verdicts.positive_synergy: interaction >= max(0.05, 0.25 * (abs(delta_s) + abs(delta_v))); interaction CI lower bound > 0; and delta_sv > max(delta_s, delta_v) with CI lower bound > 0.
verdicts.additive_benefit: delta_sv > max(delta_s, delta_v) with CI lower bound > 0, but interaction misses the positive-synergy threshold or its CI includes 0.
verdicts.no_synergy: delta_sv is not significantly above max(delta_s, delta_v), and interaction is not significantly negative.
verdicts.negative_interaction: interaction <= -0.05 and interaction CI upper bound < 0.
verdicts.invalid_benchmark: Any validity gate fails; report INCONCLUSIVE — BENCHMARK.

coupling_test.coupling_matters: C4 - C3 >= 0.05 and the coupling CI lower bound > 0.

mechanism_signature_checks: C4 vs max(C1, C2): fewer repeated failures
C4 vs max(C1, C2): higher requirement retention on text-only probes
C4 vs max(C1, C2): gain concentrated in stages 5-8
novelty_review_flag_only: Only if COUPLING MATTERS and POSITIVE SYNERGY and both replicate with a second model and on a second benchmark variant. This is not a novelty claim.

selection_and_stop.model_selection: C0 on dev_arena and budget_planner only, one seed each; see model_selection_plan.json.
selection_and_stop.owner_steering: Stop at model selection. Do not run the C0-C4 dev pilot or the primary matrix.
